templates.narrative: Ceased to draw Risk & Hardship Allowance from {away_from} for {station}

slots.label: First prefix day
slots.help: A weekend or holiday joined to the front of the leave. Enter the first such day, or leave blank; the slip then prints Nil.

slots.label: First day of leave
slots.help: The first day of the leave itself, not counting any prefix.

slots.label: First day away
slots.help: The earlier of the first prefix day and the first day of leave. Worked out for you.

slots.label: Station code
slots.help: The station code from the master list of location codes.

templates.narrative: Granted Risk & Hardship Allowance @ R1H1 rate from {rejoin_on} for {station}

slots.label: Station code
slots.help: The station code from the master list of location codes.

slots.label: Name of Corps
slots.help: The Corps whose notification lists the unit.

slots.label: Corps notification no. and date
slots.help: Number and date of the Corps notification that lists the unit.

slots.label: Serial in the notification
slots.help: The serial at which the unit appears in that notification.

slots.label: Last day of leave
slots.help: The last day of the leave itself, not counting any suffix.

slots.label: Last suffix day
slots.help: A weekend or holiday joined to the end of the leave. Enter the last such day, or leave blank; the slip then prints Nil.

slots.label: Last day away
slots.help: The later of the last day of leave and the last suffix day. Worked out for you.

slots.label: Rejoining day
slots.help: The day after the last day away. Worked out for you.
